verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs show relevant building blocks — a Figma connector, Slack/Linear interfaces that let non-engineers prompt the agent, and full PR/branch creation — implying a PM could describe a design and get code without direct engineering handoff. However, there is no concrete workflow, case study, or example showing a mockup/design being turned into a working implementation end-to-end. Missing for 10: an explicit design-to-code workflow example, evidence of Figma-to-PR pipeline, and PM-specific case studies or testimonials showing the handoff-free process actually works.
